csv_project_name: AE for US 40 Aberdeen Train Station-Havre De Grace
csv_scope_of_work: Harford County, Maryland is issuing this Request for Proposals (RFP) for developing a shared-use path for Bicycle and pedestrian use along US 40 from the City of Aberdeen to the City of Havre de Grace. The project involves providing the necessary engineering services to develop the shared path. The PI design will include preliminary design of a comfortable, convenient, and safe shared-use path along U S 40 that connects to transit and neighborhoods serving bicyclists and pedestrians along the corridor and will be based upon the preferred concept alignments designated as the Westbound Option and Combined Option in the concept plan.
